from pathlib import Path
root=Path('tests/zigbee_device_emulator/managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee')
patterns=['power_config','poll_control']
files=[]
for p in root.rglob('*.h'):
    if any(x in p.name for x in patterns): files.append(p)
for p in sorted(files):
    print('===',p,'===')
    lines=p.read_text(errors='ignore').splitlines()
    needles=['server_config','create_cluster_desc','cluster_desc_add_attr','BATTERY','battery','POLL','poll','check_in','long_poll','short_poll']
    emitted=set()

        if any(n in line for n in needles):
            lo=max(0,i-5); hi=min(len(lines),i+18)
            if (lo,hi) in emitted: continue
            emitted.add((lo,hi))
            print('\n'.join(f'{j+1}:{lines[j]}' for j in range(lo,hi)))
print('=== zed sleep/poll APIs ===')
for p in root.rglob('*.h'):
    text=p.read_text(errors='ignore')
    if any(n in text for n in ['keep_alive','poll_interval','sleep_now','ED_TIMEOUT','end_device_timeout']):
        hits=[]
        ls=text.splitlines()
        for i,l in enumerate(ls):
            if any(n in l for n in ['keep_alive','poll_interval','sleep_now','ED_TIMEOUT','end_device_timeout']):
                hits.append(i)
        if hits:
            print('---',p,'---')
